audit.description: Changed production code replaces python-dotenv imports with real environs usage in PyFunceble/config/loader.py and PyFunceble/storage.py, importing Env from environs and calling Env().read_env(...) where load_dotenv(...) was previously used. The helper module removes the direct dotenv import and implements file updates without referencing dotenv or python_dotenv. Dynamic evidence shows target imports and Env attribute access from production repo code, while source imports occur only inside the installed environs dependency and not from repository production code.
evidence: PyFunceble/config/loader.py diff replaces `from dotenv import load_dotenv` with `from environs import Env` and replaces two `load_dotenv(...)` calls with `Env().read_env(...)`.
PyFunceble/storage.py diff replaces `from dotenv import load_dotenv` with `from environs import Env` and replaces four `load_dotenv(...)` calls with `Env().read_env(...)`.
PyFunceble/helpers/environment_variable.py diff removes `import dotenv`; no changed production code retains source imports according to static file checks.
Dynamic metrics report `target_events_from_production_repo_count: 6`, including `target_import` and `target_attr_access` for `environs.Env` from PyFunceble/storage.py.
Dynamic metrics report `source_imports_from_production_repo_count: 0` and `source_imports_from_repo_count: 0`; the lone dotenv import attempt originates from installed environs under site-packages.
Dynamic metrics report `target_local_spec_count: 0` and target spec origin under site-packages/environs/__init__.py.
reasons: Production code meaningfully uses environs.Env().read_env for environment file loading.
No changed production file imports or dynamically accesses dotenv/python_dotenv.
No local fake environs provider is indicated; target origin resolves to site-packages and target_local_spec_count is 0.
